threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 149 and 243 will get you anywhere on time. Welcome to Hackney – it's all about the 'when' not 'if' with buses.
Last night on the 333, a guy got on with a full drum kit. He set up in the back and started playing beats. Just another night in Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a packed U-Bahn at midnight, everyone dancing to a busker's saxophone. Felt like real Berlin magic.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a Kebab stand with a dance floor next door—a late-night snack and dance party in one spot!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a real local by how they know to pre-order their tacos at La Taqueria to dodge the lunch crowd. Tourists just queue up.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a couple of tourists trying to coax a dog off the Muni tracks today, while the driver just sat there, probably wondering who to blame.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all bars serve vermut on tap. Only the best, like La Xampanyeria, get it right. The rest just pour a bottle and call it a day.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot a recent arrival by their struggle with the local dialect; they’ll ask for 'soda' instead of 'refrescos' at the corner bar.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when you see a 'Brixton' bus go past, like it’s a secret society initiation.
Last Friday on the 197, a bloke serenaded the whole bus with Adele. We all pretended to ignore it, but the smiles were impossible to hide.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I walked past the Kottbusser Tor late at night and saw a group of kids setting up a spontaneous concert right there on the street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you find a café that doubles as a vinyl shop, where locals sip coffee while flipping through records. Smells like nostalgia.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: People who actually live here never blink when a dog on the tracks delays Muni. It's just another day in the Mission.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus delayed at Civic Center, because a dog decided it was time for a stroll on the tracks. Only in San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just pop into a bar and order a ‘tapa’ expecting a full meal. Here, it’s more of a snack before the real food comes later.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still take photos of the Mercat de Sant Antoni like it's a hidden gem, oblivious to the throngs of locals grabbing brunch.
